title: 両面式小売店ゴンドラ棚
description: コンビニや小売店の売場通路に並べる、自立した両面ゴンドラ棚。左右の支柱には実際に貫通する取付長穴があり、中央背板、引き込まれた蹴込み台、片面四段ずつ計八枚の棚板、三角支持金具と取付爪風部品、無記載のプライス帯を備えます。商品や値札文字は含みません。高さ調整・荷重・実用上の安全性は再現または検証していません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.286 × 1.968 × 1.082 m、9,256三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A freestanding double-sided gondola for convenience-store and retail aisles. Two uprights have actual through mounting slots, with a central backing panel, recessed toe plinth, eight shelf decks arranged four per face, triangular support brackets, hook-form attachments and blank price strips. No goods or price lettering are included. Height adjustment, load behavior and operational safety are not implemented or validated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.286 × 1.968 × 1.082 m; 9,256 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
